talents.name: Improved Wrath
descriptions: Reduces the cast time of your Wrath spell by 0 sec and its Mana cost by 50%.

talents.name: Genesis
descriptions: Increases the periodic damage and healing done by your spells and abilities by 1%.

talents.name: Moonglow
descriptions: Reduces the Mana cost of your damaging spells by 25%.

talents.name: Improved Entangling Roots
descriptions: Increases the damage done by your Entangling Roots spell by 75%, and its victims can take up to 75% more damage without interrupting the effect.

talents.name: Nature's Majesty
descriptions: Increases your critical strike chance with spells and melee attacks by 1%.

talents.name: Nature's Splendor
descriptions: Increases the duration of your Moonfire and Rejuvenation spells by 3 sec, your Regrowth spell by 6 sec, and your Insect Swarm spell by 2 sec.

talents.name: Nature's Reach
descriptions: Increases the range of your offensive Balance spells by 20% and improves your chance to hit by 4%.

talents.name: Insect Swarm
descriptions: The enemy target is swarmed by insects, decreasing their chance to hit with attacks by 2% and causing 48 Nature damage over <!--sp1223083:0-->12 sec<!--sp1223083-->.

talents.name: Improved Moonfire
descriptions: Increases the damage and critical strike chance of your Moonfire spell by 2%.

talents.name: Vengeance
descriptions: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Arcane and Nature spells by 20%.

talents.name: Improved Starfire
descriptions: Reduces the cast time of Starfire by 1 sec and Starfire has a 15% chance to stun its target for 3 sec.

talents.name: Nature's Grace
descriptions: All non-periodic spell criticals grace you with a blessing of nature, increasing your spellcasting speed and reducing your global cooldown by 10% for 3 sec.

talents.name: Eclipse
descriptions: Your Wrath spell reduces the cast time of your next 2 Starfire spells by 0.03 sec. Stores up to 4 charges. Lasts 15 sec.

talents.name: Moonfury
descriptions: Increases the damage done by your Arcane and Nature spells by 2%.

talents.name: Moonkin Form
descriptions:
Shapeshift into Moonkin Form, increasing Omen of Clarity's chance to trigger by 100%, Armor contribution from items by 360%, and all party members within 45 yards have their Critical Strike chance increased by 3%, exclusive with Leader of the Pack. Also protects the caster from Polymorph effects and prevents the use of healing spells.

The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects.

talents.name: Overgrowth
descriptions: Increases the maximum number of targets you may have affected by Entangling Roots by 2.

talents.name: Ferocity
descriptions: Reduces the cost of your Maul, Primal Bite, Swipe, Claw, and Rake abilities by 1 Rage or Energy.

talents.name: Heart of the Wild
descriptions: Increases your Intellect by 10%.  In addition, while in Bear Form or Dire Bear Form your Stamina is increased by 20% and while in Cat Form your Strength is increased by 10%.

talents.name: Feral Instinct
descriptions: Increases damage done by your Swipe ability by 3% and reduces the chance enemies have to detect you while Prowling as if you were 1 <!--singular:level:levels-->levels<!--singular--> higher.

talents.name: Brutal Impact
descriptions: Increases the stun duration of your Bash and Pounce abilities by 1 sec and reduces the cooldown of Bash by 30 sec.

talents.name: Thick Hide
descriptions: While in Bear Form, Cat Form, Dire Bear Form, or Moonkin Form, you gain <!--ppl1:60:3:300-->180 additional base Armor per level and another 1.00 base Armor for each point of defense skill beyond five times your level. This amount can be further increased by multipliers from those forms.

talents.name: Feral Swiftness
descriptions: Increases your movement speed while in Cat Form by 30%, and increases your chance to Dodge by 4%.

talents.name: Feral Charge
descriptions:
Requires Bear Form, Dire Bear Form
Charge an enemy, immobilizing them and interrupting any spell they are casting for 4 sec.


Feral Charge (Cat)
8 - 25 yd range
Instant30 sec cooldown
Requires Druid
Requires level 1
Requires Cat Form
Leap behind an enemy.

talents.name: Shredding Attacks
descriptions: Reduces the Energy cost of your Shred ability by 6 and reduces the Rage cost of your Lacerate ability by 6.

talents.name: Sharpened Claws
descriptions: Increases your critical strike chance while in Bear Form, Dire Bear Form, or Cat Form by 2%.

talents.name: Blood Frenzy
descriptions: Gives you a 100% chance to gain an additional 5 Rage any time you get a critical strike while in Bear Form or Dire Bear Form. In addition, your non-periodic critical strikes from Cat Form abilities that generate Combo Points have a 0% chance to add an additional Combo Point.

talents.name: Savage Fury
descriptions: Increases the damage caused by your Claw, Rake, Shred, Maul, and Swipe abilities by 20%.

talents.name: Primal Bite
descriptions: Bite the target, dealing 100% normal damage plus 26 and generating a high amount of threat.<!--cooldown:417141:until canceled-->

talents.name: Natural Instinct
descriptions: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your melee abilities by 20% and increases your spell healing by 25% of your Intellect.

talents.name: Shifting Power
descriptions: Instantly convert 0 Mana into 40 Energy. Shifting Power's cost is reduced by effects that reduce the cost of Shapeshifting.

talents.name: Predatory Strikes
descriptions: Increases your melee Attack Power in Cat Form, Bear Form, and Dire Bear Form by 50% of your level.

talents.name: Rend and Tear
descriptions: Increases damage done by your melee abilities on Bleeding targets by 20%.

talents.name: Natural Reaction
descriptions: Increases your dodge chance by 0%, and gives you a 3% chance to gain 5 Rage each time you dodge.

talents.name: Leader of the Pack
descriptions: While in Cat Form, Bear Form, or Dire Bear Form, the Leader of the Pack increases the critical strike chance of all party members within 45 yards by 3%, exclusive with Moonkin Aura.

talents.name: Berserk
descriptions:
Requires Cat Form, Bear Form, Dire Bear Form
Causes your Primal Bite ability to strike up to 3 targets, removes its cooldown, and increases the critical strike chance of your Combo Point-generating abilities by 100%. Clears and grants immunity to Fear effects for the duration. Lasts 15 sec.

talents.name: Improved Shifting Power
descriptions: Reduces the cooldown of your Shifting Power spell by 0 sec.

talents.name: Improved Tranquility
descriptions: Reduces threat caused by Tranquility by 100% and its cooldown by 60%.

talents.name: Wild Growth
descriptions: Heals the target and their party for 336 over 7 sec. Party members must be within 43.5 yards of target. The amount healed is applied quickly at first, and slows down as Wild Growth reaches its full duration.

talents.name: Living Spirit
descriptions: Increases your Spirit by 15%.

talents.name: Swiftmend
descriptions: Instantly heals a target with an active Rejuvenation or Regrowth effect for an amount equal to the full duration of the periodic effect of one of those spells.

talents.name: Improved Regrowth
descriptions: Increases the critical effect chance of your Regrowth spell by 10%.

talents.name: Improved Rejuvenation
descriptions: Increases the effect of your Rejuvenation spell by 5%.

talents.name: Tranquil Spirit
descriptions: Reduces the mana cost of your Healing Touch and Tranquility spells by 2%.

talents.name: Gift of Nature
descriptions: Increases the effect of all your healing spells by 2%.

talents.name: Reflection
descriptions: Allows 50% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

talents.name: Gift of the Earthmother
descriptions: Reduces the global cooldown by 0.5 seconds on your Rejuvenation, Swiftmend, and Wild Growth spells.

talents.name: Natural Shapeshifter
descriptions: Reduces the mana cost of all shapeshifting by 10%.

talents.name: Subtlety
descriptions: Reduces the threat generated by your Nature and Arcane spells by 30%.

talents.name: Nature's Swiftness
descriptions: When activated, your next Nature spell becomes an instant cast spell.

talents.name: Naturalist
descriptions: Reduces the cast time of your Healing Touch spell by 0 sec and increases all damage you deal by 100%.

talents.name: Nature's Focus
descriptions: Gives you a 14% chance to avoid interruption caused by damage while casting Arcane and Nature spells.

talents.name: Furor
descriptions:
Gives you a 20% chance to gain 10 Rage when shapeshifting into Bear Form or Dire Bear Form. Shapeshifting into Cat Form restores 20% of the Energy you had when last in Cat Form, plus 2 Energy per sec spent outside Cat Form, up to 20 Energy.

Bear Form and Dire Bear Form forfeit this Energy and halt its restoration while active.

talents.name: Deadly Aspects
descriptions: While Aspect of the Hawk is active, Auto Shot has a 10% chance of increasing ranged attack speed by 30% for 12 sec. While Aspect of the Beast is active, all melee auto attacks have a 10% chance of increasing melee attack speed by 30% for 12 sec.

talents.name: Bestial Wrath
descriptions: Send your pet into a rage causing 50% additional damage for 18 sec.  While enraged, the beast does not feel pity or remorse or fear and it cannot be stopped unless killed.

talents.name: Frenzy
descriptions: Gives your pet a 20% chance to gain a 30% attack speed increase for 8 sec after dealing a critical strike.

talents.name: Bestial Discipline
descriptions: Increases the Focus regeneration of your pets by 100% and allows 50% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

talents.name: Intimidation
descriptions: Command your pet to Stun the target for 3 sec on its next successful attack, which also gains 100% increased critical strike chance. Generates high threat.

talents.name: Spirit Bond
descriptions: While your pet is active, you and your pet will regenerate 1% of total health every 5 sec.

talents.name: Summon Hawk
descriptions: Command a hawk to dive-bomb your targeted enemy, dealing [32 / Ferocity: 48 / Unleashed Fury: 52 + (Ranged Attack Power * (0.05))] Physical damage and continuing its assault for 18 sec. Only 2 hawks can be active at once. Summon Hawk shares its cooldown with Arcane Shot.

talents.name: Ferocity
descriptions: Increases the critical strike chance of your pets and hawks by 16%.

talents.name: Improved Mend Pet
descriptions: Gives your Mend Pet spell a 50% chance of cleansing 1 Curse, Disease, Magic, or Poison effect from your pet each time it heals and reduces the Mana cost by 20%.

talents.name: Unleashed Fury
descriptions: Increases the damage done by your pets and hawks by 20%.

talents.name: Bestial Swiftness
descriptions: Increases the movement speed of your pets by 30%.

talents.name: Improved Revive Pet
descriptions: Revive Pet's casting time is reduced by 6 sec, mana cost is reduced by 40%, and increases the health your pet returns with by an additional 30%.

talents.name: Pathfinding
descriptions: Increases the speed bonus of your Aspect of the Cheetah and Aspect of the Pack by 6%.

talents.name: Improved Aspect of the Monkey
descriptions: Increases the Dodge bonus of your Aspect of the Monkey by 4%. Additionally, your pet gains 50% of the effect of your Aspect of the Monkey ability.

talents.name: Focused Fire
descriptions: Increases all damage you and your pet deal by 2% while your pet is active.

talents.name: Endurance Training
descriptions: Increases the Health and Armor of your pets by 15%.

talents.name: Sniper Shot
descriptions: A long-range shot that deals ranged damage plus 160 and increases the range of your next 3 Shots by 10 yards for 10 sec.

talents.name: Ranged Weapon Specialization
descriptions: Increases the damage you deal with ranged weapons by 5%.

talents.name: Rapid Recuperation
descriptions: Hitting a target with your Serpent Sting ability grants you 50% and consuming Rapid Killing grants you 100% of your Mana regeneration while casting for the next 15 sec.

talents.name: Scatter Shot
descriptions: A short-range shot that deals 50% weapon damage and disorients the target for 4 sec.  Any damage caused will remove the effect.  Turns off your attack when used.

talents.name: Barrage
descriptions: Increases the damage done by your Multi-Shot, Aimed Shot, and Volley abilities by 15%.

talents.name: Mortal Shots
descriptions: Increases the critical strike damage bonus on all ranged abilities by 30%.

talents.name: Trueshot Aura
descriptions: Increases the Ranged Attack Power of party members within 45 yds by 30.

talents.name: Rapid Killing
descriptions: Reduces the cooldown on your Rapid Fire ability by 2 min. In addition, when you kill a non-trivial enemy or it dies while afflicted by your Serpent Sting, you gain Rapid Killing, increasing the damage of your next Shot ability within 20 sec by 20%.

talents.name: Improved Arcane Shot
descriptions: Reduces the cooldown of your Arcane Shot by 2 sec. Does not affect the cooldown of abilities which share a cooldown with Arcane Shot.

talents.name: Lone Wolf
descriptions: You deal 20% increased damage with all attacks while you do not have an active pet.

talents.name: Careful Aim
descriptions: Increases your Attack Power by 100% of your Intellect.

talents.name: Efficiency
descriptions: Reduces the Mana cost of your Shots, Stings, and melee abilities by 15%.

talents.name: Lethal Attacks
descriptions: Increases your critical strike chance with all attacks by 1%.

talents.name: Improved Concussive Shot
descriptions: Gives your Concussive Shot a 0% chance to stun the target for 3 sec.

talents.name: Hawk Eye
descriptions: Increases the range of your ranged weapons by 6 yards.

talents.name: Improved Stings
descriptions: Increases the damage of your Serpent Sting ability by 20%, reduces the cooldown of your Viper Sting ability by 6 sec, and increases the duration of your Scorpid Sting ability by 45 sec.

talents.name: Strider Kick
descriptions: A powerful kick that deals 100% melee weapon damage and increases movement speed by 30% for 3 sec.

talents.name: Resourcefulness
descriptions: Reduces the mana cost of your Trap abilities and melee abilities by 60%. In addition, your critical strikes have a 60% chance to allow 50% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting for 30 sec.

talents.name: Lacerating Strikes
descriptions: Your Mongoose Bite also causes the target to Bleed for damage equal to 40% of the damage done by Mongoose Bite over 21 sec

talents.name: Expose Prey
descriptions: Your attacks against targets with Hunter's Mark have a 10% chance to activate your Mongoose Bite for 10 sec.

talents.name: Deterrence
descriptions: When activated, increases your Dodge and Parry chance by 25% for 10 sec.<!--cooldown:1310496:3 min cooldown-->

talents.name: Surefooted
descriptions: Increases your hit chance by 3% and reduces the duration of movement impairing effects on you by 30%.

talents.name: Survival Tactics
descriptions: Increases your chance to hit with your Trap and Feign Death abilities by 17%.

talents.name: Counterattack
descriptions: A strike that becomes active after parrying an opponent's attack. This attack deals 50% weapon damage plus 26 and immobilizes the target for 5 sec. Counterattack cannot be blocked, dodged, or parried.

talents.name: Improved Wing Clip
descriptions: Gives your Wing Clip ability a 20% chance to immobilize the target for 5 sec.

talents.name: Clever Traps
descriptions: Increases the duration of Freezing and Frost trap effects by 30% and the damage of Immolation and Explosive trap effects by 30%.

talents.name: Survivalist
descriptions: Increases your total Health by 10%.

talents.name: Savage Strikes
descriptions: Increases the critical strike chance of all your melee abilities by 20%.

talents.name: Entrapment
descriptions: When your traps are triggered, all affected targets are Entrapped, preventing them from moving for 5 sec.

talents.name: Deflection
descriptions: Increases your Parry chance by 5%.

talents.name: Improved Tracking
descriptions: While tracking Beasts, Demons, Dragonkin, Elementals, Giants, Humanoids, or Undead, all damage you deal to the tracked creature type is increased by 5%.

talents.name: Lightning Reflexes
descriptions: Increases your Agility by 15%.

talents.name: Survivalist's Discipline
descriptions: Reduces the cooldown of your Trap and Deterrence abilities by 40%.

talents.name: Predator's Edge
descriptions: Increases your melee critical strike damage by 30% and your Off Hand weapon damage by 50%.

talents.name: Arcane Power
descriptions: For the next 15 sec, your spells deal 30% more damage while costing 30% more mana to cast.

talents.name: Arcane Instability
descriptions: Increases the damage done by your spells by 1% and your critical strike chance by 1%.

talents.name: Arcane Mind
descriptions: Increases your Intellect by 10% and increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Arcane spells by 100%.

talents.name: Presence of Mind
descriptions: When activated, your next Mage spell with a casting time less than 10 sec becomes an instant cast spell.

talents.name: Missile Barrage
descriptions: Gives your Arcane Blast spell a 40% chance, and your Fireball, Frostbolt, and Frostfire Bolt spells a 20% chance to reduce the channeled duration of your next Arcane Missiles spell by 50%, reduce the Mana cost by 100%, and missiles fire every 0.5 sec.

talents.name: Arcane Meditation
descriptions: Allows 50% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

talents.name: Improved Counterspell
descriptions: Your Counterspell also Silences the target for 4 sec.

talents.name: Arcane Shielding
descriptions: Decreases the Mana lost per point of damage taken when your Mana Shield spell is active by 33% and increases the resistances granted by your Mage Armor spell by 50%.

talents.name: Arcane Blast
descriptions: Blasts the target with energy, dealing <!--ppl20:28:54:90-->57 to 65 Arcane damage. Each time you cast Arcane Blast, the damage of all your other spells is increased by 10% and the mana cost of Arcane Blast is increased by 175%. Effect stacks up to 4 times and lasts 8 sec or until any other damage spell is cast.

talents.name: Arcane Impact
descriptions: Increases the critical strike chance of your Arcane spells by 6%.

talents.name: Arcane Geometry
descriptions: Increases the range of your Arcane spells by 6 yards.

talents.name: Arcane Resilience
descriptions: Increases your Armor by an amount equal to 50% of your Intellect.

talents.name: Arcane Concentration
descriptions: Gives you a 100% chance of entering a Clearcasting state after any damage spell hits a target.  The Clearcasting state reduces the mana cost of your next damage spell by 100%.

talents.name: Magic Absorption
descriptions: Increases all your resistances by 2 and causes all spells you fully resist to restore 1% of your total mana. Cannot trigger more often than 1 time per sec.

talents.name: Arcane Subtlety
descriptions: Reduces your target's resistance to all your spells by 15 and reduces the threat caused by your Arcane spells by 30%.

talents.name: Improved Channeling
descriptions: Gives you a 20% chance to avoid interruption caused by damage while channeling Arcane Missiles and a 14% chance while casting Arcane Blast.

talents.name: Arcane Focus
descriptions: Improves your chance to hit with Arcane spells by 2%.

talents.name: Wand Specialization
descriptions: Increases your damage with Wands by 13%.

talents.name: Combustion
descriptions: When activated, this spell causes each of your Fire damage spell hits to increase your critical strike chance with Fire damage spells by 10%.  This effect lasts until you have caused 3 non-periodic critical strikes with Fire spells.

talents.name: Fire Power
descriptions: Increases the damage done by your Fire spells by 2%.

talents.name: Blast Wave
descriptions: A wave of flame radiates outward from the caster, damaging all enemies caught within the blast for <!--ppl30:36:163:100-->154 to 184 Fire damage, and Dazing them for 50% reduced movement speed for 6 sec.

talents.name: Critical Mass
descriptions: Increases the critical strike chance of your Fire spells by 2%.

talents.name: Master of Elements
descriptions: Your Fire and Frost critical strikes will refund 10% of their base mana cost.

talents.name: Heating Up
descriptions: Non-periodic critical strikes with Fireball, Frostfire Bolt, Fire Blast, and Scorch reduce the cast time of your next Pyroblast cast within 20 sec by 25%, stacking up to 3 times.

talents.name: Improved Fire Ward
descriptions: Causes your Fire Ward to have a 20% chance to reflect Fire spells while active.

talents.name: Improved Scorch
descriptions: Your Scorch spell has a 100% chance to cause your target to be vulnerable to Fire damage. This vulnerability increases all Fire damage you deal to your target by 3% and lasts 30 sec, stacking up to 5 times.

talents.name: Burning Soul
descriptions: Gives your Fire spells a 70% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage and reduces the threat caused by your Fire spells by 30%.

talents.name: Pyroblast
descriptions: Hurls an immense fiery boulder that causes <!--ppl20:24:110:150-->101 to 131 Fire damage and an additional 44 Fire damage over 12 sec.

talents.name: Improved Flamestrike
descriptions: Increases the critical strike chance of your Flamestrike spell by 15%.

talents.name: Impact
descriptions: Gives your Fire spells a 10% chance to stun the target for 2 sec.

talents.name: Flame Throwing
descriptions: Increases the range of your Fire spells by 6 yards.

talents.name: Ignite
descriptions: Your critical strikes from Fire damage spells cause the target to burn for an additional 40% of your spell's damage over 4 sec.

talents.name: Improved Fireball
descriptions: Reduces the casting time of your Fireball and Frostfire Bolt spells by 1 sec.

talents.name: Incineration
descriptions: Increases the critical strike chance of your Fire Blast, Ice Lance, Arcane Blast, and Scorch spells by 6%.

talents.name: Wake of Fire
descriptions: Reduces the cooldown of your Fire Blast spell by 2 sec. Killing a non-trivial target increases the critical strike chance of your next Fire Blast cast within 30 sec by 50%.

talents.name: Ice Barrier
descriptions: Instantly shields you, absorbing <!--ppl40:46:431:280-->448 damage. Lasts 1 min. While the shield holds, your spellcasts will not be interrupted or delayed from taking damage.

talents.name: Winter's Chill
descriptions: Gives your Frost damage spells a 0% chance to apply the Winter's Chill effect, which increases the chance your Ice Lance and Frostbolt spells will critically hit the target by 2% for 15 sec. Stacks up to 5 times.

talents.name: Fingers of Frost
descriptions: Gives your Chill effects a 15% chance to grant you the Fingers of Frost effect, which treats your next 2 <!--singular:spell:spells-->spells<!--singular--> cast as if the target were Frozen. Lasts 15 sec.

talents.name: Improved Cone of Cold
descriptions: Increases the damage dealt by your Cone of Cold spell by 15%.

talents.name: Cold Snap
descriptions: Finishes the remaining cooldown on all your other Frost spells.

talents.name: Ice Lance
descriptions: Deals <!--ppl20:26:28:35-->28 to 32 Frost damage to an enemy target. Deals 300% increased damage to Frozen targets.

talents.name: Shatter
descriptions: Increases the critical strike chance of all your spells against Frozen targets by 1%.

talents.name: Ice Block
descriptions: You become encased in a block of ice, protecting you from all physical attacks and spells for 10 sec, but during that time you cannot attack, move, or cast spells.

talents.name: Arctic Reach
descriptions: Increases the range of your Frostbolt and Blizzard spells and the radius of your Frost Nova and Cone of Cold spells by 10%.

talents.name: Improved Blizzard
descriptions: Adds a Chill effect to your Blizzard spell. This effect lowers the target's movement speed by 40% for 1.5 sec.

talents.name: Frost Channeling
descriptions: Reduces the mana cost of your Frost spells by 15% and reduces the threat caused by your Frost spells by 30%.

talents.name: Piercing Ice
descriptions: Increases the damage done by your Frost spells by 2%.

talents.name: Frostbite
descriptions: Gives your Chill effects a 15% chance to Freeze the target for 5 sec.

talents.name: Improved Frost Nova
descriptions: Reduces the cooldown of your Frost Nova spell by 4 sec.

talents.name: Permafrost
descriptions: Increases the duration of your Chill effects by 33% and reduces the target's speed by an additional 10%.

talents.name: Ice Shards
descriptions: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Frost spells by 100%.

talents.name: Elemental Precision
descriptions: Improves your chance to hit with Frost and Fire spells by 6%.

talents.name: Improved Frostbolt
descriptions: Reduces the casting time of your Frostbolt spell by 0 sec.

talents.name: Frost Warding
descriptions: Increases the Armor and resistance given by your Frost Armor and Ice Armor spells by 15%. In addition, gives your Frost Ward a 10% chance to reflect Frost spells and effects while active.

talents.name: Light's Vigil
descriptions: Applies Light's Vigil to the target for 30 sec. Your next Holy Shock cast on them triggers no cooldown and causes enemy targets to suffer 175 to 189 Holy damage and refund 75% of Light's Vigil's Mana cost, or allied targets to heal their party for <!--ppl40:49:324:120-->326 to 344. You may only have one Light's Vigil active per party.

talents.name: Holy Power
descriptions: Increases the critical strike chance of your Holy Shock and Holy Strike spells by 15%, and all other spells by 5%.

talents.name: Holy Shock
descriptions: Blasts the target with Holy energy, causing 129 to 139 Holy damage to an enemy, or 110 to 118 healing to an ally.

talents.name: Divine Precision
descriptions: Improves your chance to hit with Holy spells by 18%.

talents.name: Divine Favor
descriptions: When activated, gives your next Flash of Light, Holy Light, or Holy Shock spell a 100% critical effect chance.

talents.name: Purifying Power
descriptions: Reduces the mana cost of your Cleanse and Purify spells by 20% and reduces the cooldown of your Exorcism and Holy Wrath spells by 50%.

talents.name: Illumination
descriptions: After getting a critical effect from your Flash of Light, Holy Light, Light's Vigil, or Holy Shock heal spell you have a 0% chance to gain Mana equal to 50% of the base cost of the spell.

talents.name: Voice of Truth
descriptions: Grants you immunity to Silence and Interrupt effects for 6 sec.

talents.name: Unyielding Faith
descriptions: Reduces the duration of Fear and Disorient effects on you by 30%.

talents.name: Divine Intellect
descriptions: Increases your total Intellect by 2%.

talents.name: Healing Light
descriptions: Increases the amount healed by your Holy Light, Flash of Light, and Holy Shock spells by 4%.

talents.name: Improved Seals
descriptions: Increases the damage done by your Seals and Judgements by 3%.

talents.name: Spiritual Focus
descriptions: Gives your Flash of Light, Holy Light, and Light's Vigil spells a 14% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage.

talents.name: Divine Strength
descriptions: Increases your Strength by 2%.

talents.name: Reverence
descriptions: Allows 30% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

talents.name: Consecrated Ground
descriptions: Gives your Holy spells 10% increased damage against the first 4 enemies that enter your Consecration.

talents.name: Infusion of Light
descriptions: Your Holy Shock and Flash of Light critical hits reduce the cast time of your next Holy Light cast within 15 sec by 1.0 sec.

talents.name: Templar's Bulwark
descriptions: When activated, this ability grants you an absorb shield equal to 100% of your maximum health for 8 sec. Applies Forbearance for 1 min. Cannot be cast while Forbearance is active.<!--cooldown:1224697:4 min cooldown-->

talents.name: Redoubt
descriptions: Damaging melee attacks against you have a 10% chance to increase your chance to block by 0%.  Lasts 10 sec or 5 blocks.

talents.name: Reckoning
descriptions: Gives you a 0% chance to gain an extra attack after Blocking a melee attack and a 0% chance to gain an extra attack after being the victim of a non-periodic critical strike. Cannot occur more often than once every 1.5 sec.

talents.name: Holy Shield
descriptions: Increases chance to block by 30% for 10 sec, and deals 110 Holy damage for each attack blocked while active.  Damage caused by Holy Shield causes 20% additional threat. Each block expends a charge. 4 charges.

talents.name: One-Handed Weapon Specialization
descriptions: Increases the damage you deal with one-handed melee weapons by 2%.

talents.name: Toughness
descriptions: Increases your armor value from items by 2%.

talents.name: Sacred Duty
descriptions: Increases your total Stamina by 4% and reduces the cooldown of your Divine Shield, Divine Protection, and Templar's Bulwark spells by 60 sec.

talents.name: Improved Hammer of Justice
descriptions: Decreases the cooldown of your Hammer of Justice spell by 5 sec.

talents.name: Improved Righteous Fury
descriptions: While Righteous Fury is active, all damage taken is reduced by 6%.

talents.name: Anticipation

descriptions: Reduces the cooldown of your Blessing of Protection by 1 min and increases the duration of your Blessing of Freedom by 3 sec.

talents.name: Precision
descriptions: Improves your chance to hit by 1%.

talents.name: Shield Specialization
descriptions: Increases the amount of damage absorbed by your shield by 30%, and gives your blocks a 100% chance to restore 6% of your maximum Mana.  May only occur once every 3 sec.

talents.name: Improved Seal of Fury
descriptions: When Seal of Fury's shield is fully absorbed, restore 0 Mana, increased by 15% per level the attacker is above you, up to 45%.

talents.name: Swift Judgement
descriptions: Finishes the remaining cooldown on your Judgement ability and reduces the Mana cost of your next Judgement by 100%.

talents.name: Iron Creed
descriptions: Increases the threat generated by your Holy Strike ability by 30%. While Righteous Fury is active, Holy Strike also reduces your damage taken by 15% for 6 sec.

talents.name: Twist of Light
descriptions: Reduces the Mana cost of your Seal spells by 20%, and when you replace your Seal of Command, Seal of Righteousness, Seal of Fury, or Seal of Justice with a different Seal, you gain an Echo of that Seal. Your next melee attack applies the replaced Seal's effects, consuming the Echo.

talents.name: Vengeance
descriptions: Increases your Physical and Holy damage dealt by 5% for 30 sec after landing a non-periodic critical strike.  Stacks up to 3 times.

talents.name: Repentance
descriptions: Puts the enemy target in a state of meditation, incapacitating them for up to 6 sec. Any damage caused will awaken the target. Only works against Humanoids.

talents.name: Seal of Command
descriptions:
Gives the Paladin a chance to deal additional Holy damage equal to 70% of normal weapon damage. Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time. Lasts 30 sec.

Unleashing this Seal's energy will judge an enemy, instantly causing 69 to 73 Holy damage, 138 to 146 if the target is stunned or incapacitated.

talents.name: Two-Handed Weapon Specialization
descriptions: Increases the damage you deal with two-handed melee weapons by 2%.

talents.name: Eye for an Eye
descriptions: All critical strikes against you cause 15% of the damage taken to the attacker as well. The damage caused by Eye for an Eye will not exceed 50% of the Paladin's total health.

talents.name: Pursuit of Justice
descriptions: Increases movement speed and mounted movement speed by 15%.  This does not stack with other movement speed increasing effects.

talents.name: Sacred Arbiter
descriptions: Increases the damage of your Holy Strike ability by 20% and causes it to refresh all Judgement effects on the target.

talents.name: Sanctified Judgement
descriptions: Gives your Judgement ability a 100% chance to return 60% of the Mana cost of the judged seal.

talents.name: Vindication
descriptions: Gives your damaging melee attacks a chance to reduce the target's Attack Power by (0 /- 3 * <!--ppl0:60:6:-350--> - 204), and increase your Attack Power by 0% for 30 sec.

talents.name: Conviction
descriptions: Improves your chance to get a critical strike with melee attacks by 5%.

talents.name: Holy Conduit
descriptions: Reduces the mana cost of your Consecration, Holy Wrath, Exorcism, and Hammer of Wrath spells by 40%.

talents.name: Improved Judgement
descriptions: Decreases the cooldown of your Judgement ability by 1 sec.

talents.name: Benediction
descriptions: Reduces the Mana cost of all instant cast spells and abilities by 10%.

talents.name: Deflection
descriptions: Increases your Parry chance by 1%.

talents.name: Instrument of Law
descriptions: Reduces the cast time of your Hammer of Wrath by 1.0 sec, and reduces all threat you generate by 20% while Righteous Fury is not active.

talents.name: Champion of the Light
descriptions: Increases your spell damage by up to 100% of your Intellect.

talents.name: Penance
descriptions: Launches a volley of holy light at the target, causing <!--ppl30:39:42:29-->45 Holy damage to an enemy, or <!--ppl30:39:126:87-->134 healing to an ally, instantly and every 1 sec for 2 sec.

talents.name: Renewed Hope
descriptions: Your heals from Flash Heal, Binding Heal, Lesser Heal, Heal, Greater Heal, and Penance gain 10% increased critical strike chance when cast on targets with Weakened Soul, and reduce the remaining duration of Weakened Soul on their target by 5 sec.

talents.name: Power Infusion
descriptions: Infuses the target with power, increasing their spell damage and healing done by 20% for 15 sec.

talents.name: Mental Strength
descriptions: Increases your total Intellect by 15%.

talents.name: Improved Mana Burn
descriptions: Reduces the casting time of your Mana Burn spell by 1.0 sec.

talents.name: Soul Warding
descriptions: Reduces the cooldown on your Power Word: Shield spell by 4 sec and reduces its mana cost by 15%.

talents.name: Divine Aegis
descriptions: Your critical heals create a protective shield on the target, absorbing 15% of the amount healed. Lasts 12 sec.

talents.name: Improved Inner Fire
descriptions: Increases the Armor bonus of your Inner Fire spell by 45% and increases its total charges by 12.

talents.name: Mental Agility
descriptions: Reduces the mana cost of your Smite, Holy Fire, and instant cast spells by 10%.

talents.name: Meditation
descriptions: Allows 50% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

talents.name: Inner Focus
descriptions: When activated, reduces the Mana cost of your next spell by 100% and increases its critical effect chance by 25% if it is a non-periodic spell and capable of a critical effect.

talents.name: Martyrdom
descriptions: Gives you a 0% chance to gain Focused Casting for 6 sec after being the victim of a melee or ranged critical strike. The Focused Casting effect prevents you from losing casting time when taking damage and increases your resistance to Interrupt effects by 20%.

talents.name: Improved Power Word: Shield
descriptions: Increases the damage absorbed by your Power Word: Shield by 20%.

talents.name: Silent Resolve
descriptions: Reduces the threat generated by your Holy spells by 30% and reduces the duration of Stun, Fear, and Silence effects inflicted on you by 15%.

talents.name: Twin Disciplines
descriptions: Increases the damage and healing of your instant cast spells by 5%.

talents.name: Wand Specialization
descriptions: Increases your damage with Wands by 25%.

talents.name: Holy Precision
descriptions: Improves your chance to hit with Holy spells by 18%.

talents.name: Power in Light
descriptions: Your Smite and Penance spells deal 15% increased damage to targets afflicted with your Holy Fire.

talents.name: Prayer of Mending
descriptions: Places a spell on the target that heals them for [(172 + (Healing * <!--bc-->0.42899999<!--bc-->)) * (<!--sp1225132:0-->1<!--sp1225132--> * <!--sp14898:0-->1<!--sp14898-->)] the next time they take damage or receive non-periodic healing. When the heal occurs, Prayer of Mending jumps to a party or raid member within 20 yards. Jumps up to 5 times and lasts 30 sec after each jump. This spell can only be placed on one target at a time per caster.

talents.name: Spiritual Healing
descriptions: Increases the amount healed by your spells by 2%.

talents.name: Spiritual Guidance
descriptions: Increases your spell healing by up to 25% of your total Spirit and your spell damage by up to 8% of your total Spirit.

talents.name: Spirit of Redemption
descriptions: Upon death, the priest becomes the Spirit of Redemption for 15 sec.  The Spirit of Redemption cannot move, attack, be attacked or targeted by any spells or effects.  While in this form the priest can cast any healing spell free of cost.  When the effect ends, the priest dies.

talents.name: Litany of Light
descriptions: When you cast a healing spell, gain Mana equal to 20% of the base cost of the spell if your previous heal was a different spell.

talents.name: Binding Heal
descriptions: Heals a friendly target and the caster for <!--ppl25:31:247:220-->236 to 284. Low threat.

talents.name: Searing Light
descriptions: Increases your Holy damage done by 10%, and gives a 10% chance each time your Holy Fire spell deals periodic damage for your next Holy Nova to cost no Mana.

talents.name: Improved Healing
descriptions: Reduces the Mana cost of your Lesser Heal, Heal, Greater Heal, Penance, and Prayer of Mending spells by 15%.

talents.name: Holy Reach
descriptions: Increases the range of your Smite and Holy Fire spells and the radius of your Prayer of Healing and Holy Nova spells by 10%.

talents.name: Inspiration
descriptions: Your non-periodic critical heals increase your target's Armor by 0% for 15 sec.

talents.name: Blessed Recovery
descriptions: After being struck by a melee or ranged critical hit, or suffering more than 30% of your maximum Health from a single attack, heal 8% of the damage taken over 6 sec. Refreshing this effect carries over any remaining healing.

talents.name: Holy Nova
descriptions: Causes an explosion of holy light around the caster, causing <!--ppl20:26:27:20-->26 to 30 Holy damage to all enemy targets within 10 yards and healing all party members within 10 yards for <!--ppl20:26:51:40-->50 to 57. These effects cause no threat.

talents.name: Divine Fury
descriptions: Reduces the casting time of your Smite, Holy Fire, Heal, and Greater Heal spells by 1 sec.

talents.name: Spell Warding
descriptions: Reduces all spell damage taken by 10%.

talents.name: Improved Renew
descriptions: Increases the amount healed by your Renew spell by 5%.

talents.name: Twilight Focus
descriptions: Gives you a 70% chance to avoid interruption caused by damage while casting any spell.

talents.name: Holy Specialization
descriptions: Increases the critical effect chance of your Holy spells by 1%.

talents.name: Shadowform
descriptions: Assume Shadowform, increasing your Shadow damage by 10%, reducing the Mana cost of all Shadow spells by 50%, increasing the critical strike damage bonus of your Shadow spells by 100%, and reducing Physical damage taken by you by 15%. However, you may not cast healing spells while in this form.

talents.name: Darkness
descriptions: Increases your Shadow damage done by 10%.

talents.name: Devouring Contagion
descriptions:
Reduces the mana cost of your Devouring Plague by 50%.

Targets that die while Devouring Plague is active spreads it, jumping to a nearby enemy within 10 yds for the remaining duration.

talents.name: Vampiric Embrace
descriptions: Afflicts your target with Shadow energy that causes all party members to be healed for 20% of any Shadow spell damage you deal for 30 sec.

talents.name: Shadow Weaving
descriptions: Your Shadow damage spells have a 100% chance to increase the Shadow damage you deal by 2% for 15 sec, stacking up to 5 times.

talents.name: Improved Fade
descriptions: Decreases the cooldown of your Fade ability by 6 sec.

talents.name: Silence
descriptions: Silences the target, preventing them from casting spells for 5 sec and interrupting their spellcasts for 3 sec.

talents.name: Improved Mind Flay
descriptions: Your Mind Flay now deals 20% more damage, gains 10 yards increased range, but slows the target's movement speed by 80%.

talents.name: Mind Flay
descriptions: Assault the target's mind with Shadow energy, causing 63 Shadow damage over 3 sec  and slowing their movement speed by <!--sp1225139:0-->50<!--sp1225139-->%.

talents.name: Improved Mind Blast
descriptions: Reduces the cooldown of your Mind Blast spell by 3 sec.

talents.name: Improved Psychic Scream
descriptions: Reduces the cooldown of your Psychic Scream spell by 4 sec.

talents.name: Shadow Reach
descriptions: Increases the range of your offensive Shadow spells by 20%.

talents.name: Improved Shadow Word: Pain
descriptions: Increases the duration of your Shadow Word: Pain spell by 6 sec.

talents.name: Shadow Affinity
descriptions: Reduces the threat generated by your Shadow spells by 8%.

talents.name: Blackout
descriptions: Gives your Shadow damage spells a 10% chance to stun the target for 3 sec.

talents.name: Spirit Tap
descriptions: Gives you a 0% chance to increase your Spirit by 100% for 15 sec after killing a non-trivial target or when an enemy afflicted by your Vampiric Embrace dies. For the duration, 50% of your Mana regeneration will continue while casting.

talents.name: Shadow Focus
descriptions: Improves your chance to hit with Shadow spells by 5%.

talents.name: Early Demise
descriptions: Increases Shadow Word: Death's critical strike chance on targets at or below 20% health by 30%.

talents.name: Mutilate
descriptions: Instantly attacks with both weapons for 75% weapon damage plus an additional 17 with each weapon. Damage increased by 20% against Poisoned targets. Awards 2 Combo <!--singular:Point:Points-->Points<!--singular-->.

talents.name: Seal Fate
descriptions: Your critical strikes from abilities that add Combo Points have a 0% chance to add an additional Combo Point.

talents.name: Improved Kidney Shot
descriptions: Enemies Stunned by your Kidney Shot ability take 10% increased damage from your poisons and attacks.

talents.name: Venom
descriptions:
Finishing move that increases the damage of your Poisons by 30% and your chance to apply Poisons by 10%. Lasts longer per combo point:
1 point : 9 sec
2 points: 12 sec
3 points: 15 sec
4 points: 18 sec
5 points: 21 sec

talents.name: Improved Poisons
descriptions: Increases the chance to apply Poisons to your target by 10%, and gives Poison applications a 50% chance to not consume a charge.

talents.name: Vile Poisons
descriptions: Increases the damage dealt by your poisons by 20% and gives your poisons an additional 40% chance to resist dispel effects.

talents.name: Cold Blood
descriptions: When activated, increases the critical strike chance of your next Sinister Strike, Backstab, Ambush, Eviscerate, or Mutilate by 100%.

talents.name: Lethality
descriptions: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Sinister Strike, Gouge, Backstab, Mutilate, Ghostly Strike, and Hemorrhage abilities by 6%.

talents.name: Improved Expose Armor
descriptions: Reduces the Energy cost of your Expose Armor ability by 10, and refunds 2 Combo <!--singular:Point:Points-->Points<!--singular--> when cast with 5 Combo Points.

talents.name: Vigor
descriptions: Increases your maximum Energy by 10.

talents.name: Murder
descriptions: Increases all damage dealt by 4% against Humanoid and Giant targets.

talents.name: Ruthlessness
descriptions: Gives your finishing moves a 60% chance to add a Combo Point to your target.

talents.name: Malice
descriptions: Increases your critical strike chance with all attacks and Poisons by 5%.

talents.name: Remorseless Attacks
descriptions: After killing a non-trivial enemy, gives you a 0% increased critical strike chance on your next Sinister Strike, Backstab, Ambush, Mutilate, or Ghostly Strike. Lasts 20 sec.

talents.name: Improved Slice and Dice
descriptions: Increases the duration of your Slice and Dice ability by 15%.

talents.name: Improved Gouge
descriptions: Increases the duration of your Gouge ability by 2 sec.

talents.name: Relentless Strikes
descriptions: Your finishing moves have a 0% chance per Combo Point to restore 25 Energy.

talents.name: Improved Eviscerate
descriptions: Increases the damage done by your Eviscerate ability by 20%.

talents.name: Puncturing Wounds
descriptions: Increases the critical strike chance of your Backstab by 30% and your Mutilate by 15%, and gives Backstab a 45% chance to add an additional Combo Point.

talents.name: Adrenaline Rush
descriptions: Increases your Energy regeneration rate by 100% for 15 sec.

talents.name: Weapon Expertise
descriptions: Reduces the chance for your attacks to be Dodged or Parried by 2%.

talents.name: Hack and Slash
descriptions:
Gives your melee weapon attacks a benefit depending on the weapon.

Axe/Sword: Your successful
melee attacks have a 5% chance
to trigger an extra attack on the
target.

Dagger/Fist: Increases your
critical strike chance by 5%.

Mace: Your attacks ignore 15% of
your target's armor.

talents.name: Blade Flurry
descriptions: Increases your melee attack speed by 20% and your melee attacks strike an additional nearby opponent. Lasts 15 sec.

talents.name: Aggression
descriptions: Increases the damage of your Sinister Strike, Backstab, and Eviscerate abilities by 2%.

talents.name: Improved Sprint
descriptions: Gives a 100% chance to remove all movement impairing effects when you activate your Sprint ability.

talents.name: Improved Kick
descriptions: Gives your Kick ability a 100% chance to Silence the target for 2 sec.

talents.name: Riposte
descriptions: A strike that becomes active after parrying an opponent's attack.  This attack deals 150% weapon damage and disarms the target for 6 sec.

talents.name: Endurance
descriptions: Reduces the cooldown of your Sprint and Evasion abilities by 60%.

talents.name: Precision
descriptions: Improves your chance to hit by 1%.

talents.name: Deflection
descriptions: Increases your Parry chance by 1%.

talents.name: Dual Wield Specialization
descriptions: Increases the damage done by your off-hand weapon by 50%.

talents.name: Improved Sinister Strike
descriptions: Reduces the Energy cost of your Sinister Strike ability by 5.

talents.name: Flawless Execution
descriptions: Reduces the Energy cost of your Eviscerate ability by 10.

talents.name: Lightning Reflexes
descriptions: Increases your Dodge chance by 5%.

talents.name: Premeditation
descriptions: Adds 2 Combo Points to your target. You must add to or use those combo points within 20 sec or the combo points are lost.

talents.name: Dirty Deeds
descriptions: Reduces the Energy cost of your Cheap Shot and Garrote abilities by 20, and your Garrote ability no longer requires you to be behind your target.

talents.name: Preparation
descriptions: When activated, this ability immediately finishes the cooldown on your other Rogue abilities.

talents.name: Heightened Senses
descriptions: Increases your Stealth detection as if you were 3 <!--singular:level:levels-->levels<!--singular--> higher and reduces your chance to be hit by spells and ranged attacks by 6%.

talents.name: Hemorrhage
descriptions: An instant strike that deals 100% weapon damage (145% if a Dagger is equipped) and causes the target to take 15% increased Rupture damage from the Rogue. Lasts 15 sec. Awards 1 Combo <!--singular:Point:Points-->Point<!--singular-->.

talents.name: Improved Ambush
descriptions: Increases the critical strike chance of your Ambush ability by 45%.

talents.name: Cutthroat
descriptions: Your Backstab has a 15% chance to cause your next Ambush within 10 sec to not require Stealth.

talents.name: Setup
descriptions: Gives you a 0% chance to add a Combo Point to your target after Dodging one of their attacks or fully resisting one of their spells.

talents.name: Serrated Blades
descriptions: Causes your attacks to ignore 9% of your target's Armor and increases the damage dealt by your Rupture ability by 30%.

talents.name: Elusiveness
descriptions: Reduces the cooldown of your Vanish and Blind abilities by 90 sec.

talents.name: Ghostly Strike
descriptions: A strike that deals 125% (180% if a Dagger is equipped in your Main Hand) weapon damage and increases your chance to dodge by 15% for 7 sec.  Awards 1 combo <!--singular:point:points-->point<!--singular-->.

talents.name: Initiative
descriptions: Gives you a 100% chance to add an additional combo point to your target when using your Ambush, Garrote, or Cheap Shot ability.

talents.name: Camouflage
descriptions: Reduces your speed penalty from your Stealth ability by 15% and reduces its cooldown by 6 sec.

talents.name: Dirty Tricks
descriptions: Reduces the Energy cost of your Sap and Blind abilities by 50%.

talents.name: Opportunity
descriptions: Increases the damage dealt by your Backstab, Garrote, Ambush, and Mutilate abilities by 10%.

talents.name: Master of Deception
descriptions: Reduces the chance enemies have to detect you while in Stealth mode as if you were 3 <!--singular:level:levels-->levels<!--singular--> higher.

talents.name: Thousand Cuts
descriptions: When your Rupture ability deals periodic damage, the Energy cost of your next Hemorrhage or Backstab ability within 10 sec is reduced by 3, stacking up to 5 times.

talents.name: Quietus
descriptions: Your Sinister Strike, Ghostly Strike, and Hemorrhage abilities cause 10% more damage against targets below 35% health.

talents.name: Improved Distract
descriptions: Increases the radius of your Distract ability by 5 yds, and further reduces the Stealth detection of distracted enemies as though they were an additional 2 <!--singular:level:levels-->levels<!--singular--> lower.

talents.name: Lava Burst
descriptions: You hurl molten lava at the target, dealing <!--ppl40:48:164:90-->150 to 192 Fire damage. If your Flame Shock is on the target, Lava Burst deals 20% increased damage.

talents.name: Lightning Overload
descriptions: Gives your Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning spells a 30% chance to cast a second, similar spell on the same target at no additional cost that causes half damage and no threat.

talents.name: Earthbound
descriptions: Your Earthbind Totem Immobilizes nearby targets for 5 sec when cast.

talents.name: Elemental Reach
descriptions: Increases the range of your Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, Fire Nova, and Lava Burst spells by 6 yards, and increases the range of your Flame Shock spell by 15 yards.

talents.name: Call of Thunder
descriptions: Increases the critical strike chance of your Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning spells by 3%.

talents.name: Eye of the Storm
descriptions: Reduces the pushback suffered from damaging attacks while casting Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, and Lava Burst by 70%.

talents.name: Improved Fire Nova
descriptions: Increases the damage done by your Fire Nova spell by 20% and reduces its cooldown by 2 sec.

talents.name: Elemental Alacrity
descriptions: Reduces the cast time of your Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, and Lava Burst spells by 0.20 sec.

talents.name: Elemental Fury
descriptions: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Searing and Magma Totems and your Fire, Frost, and Nature spells by 100%.

talents.name: Reverberation
descriptions: Reduces the cooldown of your Shock spells by 0.2 sec.

talents.name: Elemental Focus
descriptions: Gives you a 10% chance to enter a Clearcasting state after casting any Fire, Frost, or Nature damage spell.  The Clearcasting state reduces the mana cost of your next damage spell by 100%.

talents.name: Elemental Devastation
descriptions: Your offensive spell critical strikes will increase your chance to get a critical strike with melee attacks by 0% for 10 sec.

talents.name: Call of Flame
descriptions: Increases the damage done by your Fire Totems and by your Flame Shock, Fire Nova, and Lava Burst spells by 15%.

talents.name: Elemental Warding
descriptions: Reduces damage taken from Fire, Frost, and Nature effects by 4%.

talents.name: Concussion
descriptions: Increases the damage done by your Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, and Earth Shock spells by 1%.

talents.name: Convection
descriptions: Reduces the mana cost of your Shock, Lightning Bolt, Lava Burst, and Chain Lightning spells by 2%.

talents.name: Rage of the Farseer
descriptions: Increases your attack speed by 30% for 25 sec.

talents.name: Maelstrom Weapon
descriptions: When you deal damage with a melee attack, you have a chance to reduce the cast time and Mana cost of your next Lightning Bolt spell by 20%. Stacks up to 5 times. Lasts 30 sec.

talents.name: Improved Stormstrike
descriptions: When you Stormstrike, you have a 20% chance to gain 50% mana regeneration while casting spells for 15 sec, and Stormstrike's cooldown has a 20% chance to reset each time you Dodge or Parry.

talents.name: Stormstrike
descriptions: Instantly strike for normal weapon damage and increase the damage you deal to the target with your next Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, or Earth Shock spell by 20% for 12 sec.

talents.name: Mental Quickness
descriptions: Increases your spell damage and healing by up to 30% of your Intellect.

talents.name: Spirit Weapons
descriptions: Gives a chance to parry enemy melee attacks, reduces all threat generated by your attacks by 30% while Rockbiter Weapon is not active, and increases all threat generated by 30% while Rockbiter Weapon is active.

talents.name: Toughness
descriptions: Increases your Stamina by 2%.

talents.name: Flurry
descriptions: Increases your attack speed by 1% for your next 3 swings after dealing a melee critical strike.

talents.name: Anticipation
descriptions: Increases your chance to dodge by an additional 1%.

talents.name: Shamanistic Focus
descriptions: Reduces the mana cost of your Shock and Lightning Shield spells by 45%.

talents.name: Elemental Weapons
descriptions: Increases the melee attack power bonus of your Rockbiter Weapon by 7%, your Windfury Weapon effect by 13% and increases the damage caused by your Flametongue Weapon and Frostbrand Weapon by 5%.

talents.name: Improved Lightning Shield
descriptions: Increases the damage done by your Lightning Shield orbs by 5%.

talents.name: Improved Ghost Wolf
descriptions: Reduces the cast time of your Ghost Wolf spell by 3.0 sec, and Ghost Wolf may be used indoors.

talents.name: Thundering Strikes
descriptions: Improves your chance to get a critical strike with all spells and attacks by 1%.

talents.name: Guardian Totems
descriptions: Increases the amount of damage reduced by your Stoneskin Totem and Windwall Totem by 10% and reduces the cooldown of your Grounding Totem by 1 sec.

talents.name: Mental Dexterity
descriptions: Increases your Attack Power by an amount equal to 100% of your Intellect.

talents.name: Ancestral Knowledge
descriptions: Increases your Intellect by 10%.

talents.name: Earth's Grasp
descriptions: Increases the health of your Stoneclaw Totem by 25% and the radius of your Earthbind Totem by 10%.

talents.name: Riptide
descriptions: Heals a friendly target for <!--ppl40:48:480:370-->486 to 534, an additional 445 over 15 sec, and increases the effectiveness of your Chain Heal casts directly on that target by 25%.

talents.name: Purification
descriptions: Increases the effectiveness of your healing spells by 10%.

talents.name: Nature's Swiftness
descriptions: When activated, your next Nature spell with a casting time less than 10 sec. becomes an instant cast spell.

talents.name: Healing Way
descriptions: Increases the amount healed by your Healing Wave spell by 33%.

talents.name: Mana Tide Totem
descriptions: Summons a Mana Tide Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 12 sec that restores 88 mana every 3 seconds to group members within 30 yards.

talents.name: Totemic Focus
descriptions: Reduces the Mana cost of your totems and any spells that summon or move them by 5%.

talents.name: Restorative Totems
descriptions: Increases the effect of your Mana Spring Totem by 5% and increases the effect of your Healing Stream Totem by 5%.

talents.name: Ancestral Healing
descriptions: Increases your target's armor value by 0% for 15 sec after getting a critical effect from one of your healing spells.

talents.name: Water Shield
descriptions:
The caster is surrounded by 3 globes of water. When a spell, melee, or ranged attack hits the caster or when one of the caster's healing spells gets a critical result, 2% of maximum mana is restored to the caster, expending one water globe. Only one globe will activate every few seconds. Lasts 10 min.

Only one Elemental Shield can be active on the Shaman at any one time.

talents.name: Healing Focus
descriptions: Gives you a 70% chance to avoid interruption caused by damage while casting any healing spell.

talents.name: Mindfulness
descriptions: Allows 5% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

talents.name: Tidal Focus
descriptions: Reduces the Mana cost of your healing spells by 5% and improves your chance to hit by 5%.

talents.name: Natural Grace
descriptions: Reduces the threat generated by your spells by 30%.

talents.name: Improved Reincarnation
descriptions: Reduces the cooldown of your Reincarnation spell by 10 min, increases your maximum health by 4%, and increases the amount of health and Mana you reincarnate with by an additional 10%.

talents.name: Tidal Mastery
descriptions: Increases the critical effect chance of your healing spells by 1%.

talents.name: Improved Healing Wave
descriptions: Reduces the casting time of your Healing Wave spell by 0.1 sec.

talents.name: Wrack
descriptions: Tears the target apart from within, inflicting 36 Shadow damage every 1 sec and increasing the damage they take from your other Shadow damage over time effects by 10% for 6 sec.

talents.name: Shadow Mastery
descriptions: Increases the damage dealt or life drained by your Shadow spells by 2%.

talents.name: Soul Siphon
descriptions: Increases the damage done or health drained by your Drain Life, Drain Soul, and Wrack spells by 12% per each of your other Affliction effects active on the target, up to a maximum increase of 36%.

talents.name: Siphon Life
descriptions: Transfers 11 health from the target to the caster every 3 sec.  Lasts 30 sec.

talents.name: Curse of Exhaustion
descriptions: Reduces the target's movement speed by <!--sp18288:0-->30<!--sp18288-->% for 12 sec.  Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target.

talents.name: Nightfall
descriptions: Gives your Corruption, Drain Soul, Drain Life, and Wrack spells a 4% chance to cause you to enter a Shadow Trance after damaging the opponent. The Shadow Trance reduces the casting time of your next Shadow Bolt spell by 100%.

talents.name: Amplify Curse
descriptions: Increases the effect of your next Curse of Weakness or Bane of Agony by 50%, or your next Curse of Exhaustion by 20%.  Lasts 30 sec.

talents.name: Pandemic
descriptions: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Corruption, Bane of Agony, Bane of Doom, Drain Soul, Drain Life, Siphon Life, and Wrack spells by 100%.

talents.name: Fel Concentration
descriptions: Gives you a 70% chance to avoid interruption caused by damage while channeling or casting your Drain Life, Drain Mana, Drain Soul, or Wrack spells.

talents.name: Improved Bane of Agony
descriptions: Increases the damage done by your Bane of Agony by 2%.

talents.name: Improved Drains
descriptions: Increases health drained or damage done by your Drain Life, Drain Soul, and Wrack spells by 20%.

talents.name: Improved Life Tap
descriptions: Increases the amount of Mana awarded by your Life Tap spell by 0%.

talents.name: Soul Harvest
descriptions: Killing a non-trivial target afflicted by your Drain Soul increases your Mana regeneration by 100% for 10 sec and allows 100% of normal Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

talents.name: Malediction
descriptions: Increases all periodic damage done by your Warlock spells by 10%.

talents.name: Improved Corruption
descriptions: Reduces the casting time of your Corruption spell by 2 sec and increases the damage it deals by 10%.

talents.name: Suppression
descriptions: Improves your chance to hit by 5% and reduces all threat you generate by 20%.

talents.name: Malevolence
descriptions: Increases the critical effect chance of your Shadow spells by 5%.

talents.name: Demonic Pact
descriptions: Your Demonic Sacrifice effect is no longer cancelled by summoning a different Demon pet. Resummoning the sacrificed pet will still cancel the effect.

talents.name: Master Demonologist
descriptions:
Grants both the Warlock and the summoned demon an effect as long as that demon is active.

Imp - Increases Fire damage done by 10%.

Voidwalker - Reduces Physical damage taken by 10%.

Succubus/Incubus - Increases Shadow damage done by 10%.

Felhunter - Reduces Magic damage taken by 10%.

talents.name: Soul Link
descriptions: When active, 30% of all damage taken by the caster is taken by your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, or Felhunter Demon instead. In addition, both the Demon and the master will inflict <!--pts1:0:0:25228-->3<!---->% more damage. Lasts as long as the Demon is active.

talents.name: Demonic Knowledge
descriptions: Increases your spell damage and your Demon pet's spell damage by up to 100% of your level while you have a summoned Demon pet active.

talents.name: Improved Felhunter
descriptions: Increases the Attack Power reduction of your Felhunter's Tainted Blood, the healing of its Devour Magic, and the detection level of its Paranoia by 30%, and reduces the cooldown of its Spell Lock by 6 sec.

talents.name: Fel Domination
descriptions: Your next Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, or Felhunter Summon spell has its casting time reduced by 6 sec and its Mana cost reduced by 50%.

talents.name: Demonic Brand
descriptions: Your Searing Pain generates 50% less threat and brands the target for 10 sec. Your pet's next 3 attacks against the target deal [(((<!--pl1293695:1:60-->60 - 26) * 1.5) + 14 + (0.078 * ((Shadow spell power)))) * (<!--sp23759:0-->1<!--sp23759--> * <!--sp18769:0-->1<!--sp18769--> * <!--sp23761:0-->1<!--sp23761-->)] to [(((<!--pl1293695:1:60-->60 - 26) * 1.5) + 17 + (0.078 * ((Shadow spell power)))) * (<!--sp23759:0-->1<!--sp23759--> * <!--sp18769:0-->1<!--sp18769--> * <!--sp23761:0-->1<!--sp23761-->)] Fire or Shadow damage based on the pet. If Shadow damage is dealt, it has high threat.

talents.name: Decimation
descriptions: Reduces the cooldown of your Soul Fire spell by 90%. When you cast Shadow Bolt or Searing Pain on an enemy below 35% health, they deal 0% increased damage, and for the next 10 sec your Soul Fire spell has its cast time reduced by 40% and costs no Soul Shards.

talents.name: Master Summoner
descriptions: Reduces the casting time of your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, and Felhunter Summoning spells by 4 sec and the Mana cost by 40%.

talents.name: Demonic Energies
descriptions: You heal your pet for 15% of all spell damage you deal. When you gain Mana from Life Tap, your summoned demon gains 100% of the Mana you gain.

talents.name: Demonic Sacrifice
descriptions:
When activated, sacrifices your summoned Demon to enhance the opposing aspect of your power, granting you an effect that lasts 2 hrs. The effect is canceled if any Demon is summoned.

Imp: Increases your Shadow damage by 15%.

Voidwalker: Restores 2% of your total Mana every 4 sec.

Succubus/Incubus: Increases your Fire damage by 15%.

Felhunter: Restores 3% of your total Health every 4 sec.

talents.name: Improved Sayaad
descriptions: Increases the effect of your Succubus' and Incubus' Lash of Pain and Soothing Kiss spells by 30%, and increases the duration of your Succubus' and Incubus' Seduction and Lesser Invisibility spells by 30%.

talents.name: Demonic Aegis
descriptions: Increases the effectiveness of your Demon Skin and Demon Armor spells by 30%.

talents.name: Fel Vitality
descriptions: Increases the maximum health and Mana of your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, and Felhunter by 15%, and increases your maximum Mana by 15%.

talents.name: Improved Voidwalker
descriptions: Increases the effectiveness of your Voidwalker's Torment, Consume Shadows, Sacrifice, and Suffering spells by 30%.

talents.name: Improved Health Funnel
descriptions: Increases the amount of health transferred by your Health Funnel spell by 40%, reduces its health cost by 30%, and reduces all threat your Health Funnel generates by 100%. Allows Health Funnel to be used regardless of your demon's health.

talents.name: Unholy Power
descriptions: Increases all damage done by your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, and Felhunter pets by 10%.

talents.name: Demonic Embrace
descriptions: Increases your total Stamina by 15%.

talents.name: Improved Imp
descriptions: Increases the damage of your Imp's Firebolt spell by 30% and the effect of its Fire Shield spell by 30%.

talents.name: Incinerate
descriptions: Deals <!--ppl40:49:97:110-->100 to 114 Fire damage to your target and an additional 25% damage if the target is afflicted by Immolate.

talents.name: Shadow and Flame
descriptions: Hitting an enemy with Conflagrate increases all Shadow damage you deal by 10% for 20 sec, and hitting an enemy with Shadowburn increases all Fire damage you deal by 10% for 20 sec. In addition, Conflagrate has a 100% chance not to consume Immolate, and Shadowburn has a 100% chance to instantly refund a Soul Shard.

talents.name: Bane of Havoc
descriptions: Afflicts the target for 5 min, causing 15% of all damage done by the Warlock to other targets to also be dealt to the cursed target. Bane of Havoc is limited to 1 target, and only one Bane per Warlock can be active on any one target.

talents.name: Fire and Brimstone
descriptions: Increases the critical strike chance of your Conflagrate spell by 25%.

talents.name: Pyroclasm
descriptions: Gives your Soul Fire spell a 26% chance to Stun the target for 3 sec, and your Rain of Fire and Hellfire spells a 26% chance over their duration to Stun targets they damage for 3 sec.

talents.name: Agonizing Flames
descriptions: Increases the critical strike chance of your Searing Pain spell by 10% and the damage done by all your Destruction spells by 10%.

talents.name: Conflagrate
descriptions: Ignites a target that is already afflicted by your Immolate spell, dealing <!--ppl25:30:95:90-->88 to 111 Fire damage and consuming your Immolate effect.

talents.name: Destructive Reach
descriptions: Increases the range of your damaging spells by 20%.

talents.name: Intensity
descriptions: Gives you a 70% chance to resist interruption caused by damage while casting or channeling any Destruction spell.

talents.name: Ruin
descriptions: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Destruction spells by 100%.

talents.name: Shadowburn
descriptions: Instantly blasts the target for <!--ppl20:24:66:90-->65 to 74 Shadow damage.  If a non-trivial target dies within 8 sec of being hit with Shadowburn, the caster gains a Soul Shard.

talents.name: Molten Skin
descriptions: Reduces all damage taken by 10%.

talents.name: Aftermath
descriptions: Increases the initial damage of your Immolate spell by 50% and your Conflagrate spell has a 100% chance to Daze the target, reducing the target's movement speed by 50% for 5 sec.

talents.name: Cataclysm
descriptions: Reduces the Mana cost of your Destruction spells by 10%.

talents.name: Bane
descriptions: Reduces the casting time of your Shadow Bolt, Immolate, and Incinerate spells by 1 sec and your Soul Fire spell by 2 sec.

talents.name: Improved Shadow Bolt
descriptions: Your Shadow Bolt critical strikes increase Shadow damage taken by the target from your attacks by 0% for 12 sec.

talents.name: Mortal Strike
descriptions: A vicious strike that deals weapon damage plus 85 and wounds the target, reducing the effectiveness of any healing by 50% for 10 sec.

talents.name: Improved Hamstring
descriptions: Gives your Hamstring ability a 0% chance to immobilize the target for 5 sec.

talents.name: Weaponmaster
descriptions:
Gives your melee weapon attacks a benefit depending on the weapon.

Axe/Polearm: Increases your
critical strike chance by 5%.

Mace/Staff: Your attacks ignore
15% of your target's armor.

Sword: Your successful melee
attacks have a 5% chance to
trigger an extra attack on the
target.

talents.name: Sweeping Strikes
descriptions: Your next 5 melee attacks strike an additional nearby opponent.

talents.name: Impale
descriptions: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your abilities by 10%.

talents.name: Two-Handed Weapon Specialization
descriptions: Increases the damage you deal with two-handed melee weapons by 1%.

talents.name: Spearing Strike
descriptions: A brutal attack that deals 40% weapon damage. Deals an additional 80% weapon damage against Giants, Dragonkin, and mounted targets. Mounted targets are dismounted.

talents.name: Deep Wounds
descriptions: Your critical strikes cause your opponent to Bleed, dealing 0% of your melee weapon's average damage over 12 sec.

talents.name: Anger Management
descriptions: Generates 1 Rage every 3 sec while in combat, and reduces Rage loss while out of combat by 30%.

talents.name: Improved Overpower
descriptions: Increases the critical strike chance of your Overpower ability by 25%.

talents.name: Improved Tactical Mastery
descriptions: Tactical Mastery lets you retain up to an additional 15 Rage when you change stances.

talents.name: Improved Charge
descriptions: Increases the Rage generated by your Charge ability by 3.

talents.name: Improved Rend
descriptions: Increases the Bleed damage done by your Rend ability by 15%.

talents.name: Deflection
descriptions: Increases your Parry chance by 1%.

talents.name: Improved Heroic Strike
descriptions: Reduces the cost of your Heroic Strike ability by 1 Rage.

talents.name: Bloodthrill
descriptions: Your Main Hand melee attacks against enemies afflicted by your Rend have a 15% chance to allow the use of your Overpower ability on the target. Lasts 6 sec.

talents.name: Improved Slam
descriptions: Reduces the global cooldown and cast time of your Slam ability by 0.50 sec. In addition, Slam no longer interrupts or delays your melee swing and Slam's cooldown is reduced by 3.0 sec.

talents.name: Improved Intercept
descriptions: Reduces the cooldown of your Intercept ability by 10 sec.

talents.name: Death Wish
descriptions: When activated, increases your Physical damage done by 20% and makes you immune to Fear effects, but increases all damage you take by 5%. Lasts 30 sec.

talents.name: Flurry
descriptions: Increases your melee attack speed by 1% for your next 3 swings after dealing a melee critical strike.

talents.name: Bloodthirst
descriptions: Instantly attack the target causing damage equal to 45% of your Attack Power plus 30 and increasing your movement speed by 10% for 10 sec.

talents.name: Enrage
descriptions: Gives you a 30% chance to deal 0% increased Physical damage for 12 sec after being the victim of any damaging attack.

talents.name: Improved Execute
descriptions: Reduces the Rage cost of your Execute ability by 5.

talents.name: Dual Wield Specialization
descriptions: Increases the damage done by your off-hand weapon by 5% and the Rage generated by your off-hand attacks by 5%.

talents.name: Blood Craze
descriptions: Regenerates 3% of your total Health over 6 sec after being the victim of a critical strike or suffering more than 20% of your maximum Health from a single attack.

talents.name: Piercing Howl
descriptions: Causes all enemies within 10 yds to be Dazed, reducing movement speed by 50% for 6 sec.

talents.name: Unbridled Wrath
descriptions: Gives you a 0% chance to generate 1 additional Rage when you deal melee damage with a weapon.

talents.name: Booming Voice
descriptions: Increases the area of effect of your Shouts by 50% and reduces their Rage cost by 25%.

talents.name: Cruelty
descriptions: Improves your chance to get a critical strike with melee attacks by 5%.

talents.name: Furious Precision
descriptions: Increases your chance to hit with off-hand attacks by 10%.

talents.name: Raging Blows
descriptions: Reduces the Rage cost of your Cleave and Whirlwind abilities by 3.

talents.name: Improved Berserker Rage
descriptions: Your Berserker Rage ability will instantly generate 10 Rage and has a 100% chance to remove all movement impairing effects when activated.

talents.name: Lingering Rage
descriptions: Increases the time before your Rage begins to decay after leaving combat by 0 sec.

talents.name: Gore Drinker
descriptions: Your Enrage, Berserker Rage, Bloodrage, Death Wish, and Bloodthirst abilities cause your next 3 melee attacks to restore 1.0% of your maximum Health.

talents.name: Shield Slam
descriptions: Slam the target with your shield, causing 421 to 439 damage, increased by your Block Value, and has a 50% chance of dispelling 1 magic effect on the target. Causes a very high amount of threat.

talents.name: Focused Rage
descriptions: Reduces the Rage cost of your offensive abilities by 3.

talents.name: Bastion
descriptions: Increases all damage you deal by 10% while a shield is equipped.

talents.name: Improved Shield Bash
descriptions: Gives your Shield Bash ability a 100% chance to Silence the target for 3 sec.

talents.name: Improved Shield Wall
descriptions: Reduces the cooldown of your Shield Wall ability by 11.0 min.

talents.name: Concussion Blow
descriptions: Stuns the target for 5 sec.

talents.name: Vanguard
descriptions: Your Charge ability is now usable while in Defensive Stance.

talents.name: Improved Disarm
descriptions: Reduces the cooldown of your Disarm ability by 20 secs.

talents.name: Improved Sunder Armor
descriptions: Reduces the Rage cost of your Sunder Armor ability by 3.

talents.name: Improved Revenge
descriptions: Increases damage dealt by your Revenge ability by 60%.

talents.name: Last Stand
descriptions: When activated, this ability temporarily grants you 30% of your maximum health for 20 sec. After the effect expires, the health is lost.

talents.name: Master of Defense
descriptions: Grants you a 0% chance to generate 5 Rage when you Dodge or Parry while a shield is equipped.

talents.name: Improved Thunder Clap
descriptions: Reduces the Rage cost of your Thunder Clap ability by 6.

talents.name: Improved Bloodrage
descriptions: Increases all the Rage generated by your Bloodrage ability by 50%.

talents.name: Anticipation
descriptions: Increases your Defense Skill by 20.

talents.name: Shield Specialization
descriptions: Increases your chance to Block attacks with your shield by 5% and grants you a 100% chance to generate 5 Rage when you Block.

talents.name: Defiance
descriptions: Increases all threat generated in Defensive stance by an additional 15% while a shield is equipped.

talents.name: Iron Will
descriptions: Reduces the duration of Stun and Fear effects inflicted on you by 15%.
